CustomObject.label: Approval Chain Setting
CustomObject.description:
★R9 The two things about the approval chain that are a business decision rather than a rule: which job titles mark a Regional Head, and how many levels the chain may climb above the Account Owner.
Custom Metadata rather than a custom object, deliberately, and the distinction is the one design.md draws for the rejected route table: this holds configuration, not people. A row here says "a Regional Head is somebody whose title says Regional Head", which is a rule that changes when the business changes its mind, not when somebody is promoted. Nothing here names a user — the chain is walked through User.ManagerId at submit time, so the org chart is the data and this is only how far to follow it.
One record, Default, ships with the values requirement.md states. An admin can edit it in Setup without a deploy, which is what makes "more levels later" cost nothing.
